rules.title: No guaranteed returns
rules.text: Agents must not state or imply that any account, investment, or product will guarantee returns, gains, principal protection, or freedom from loss.

rules.title: Fee disclosure
rules.text: Any fee, penalty, charge, or rate relevant to the product being discussed must be clearly stated to the customer before they commit to opening, upgrading, or purchasing it.

rules.title: Identity verification
rules.text: Account-specific details (balance, transaction history, personal information) may not be discussed until the customer's identity has been verified using at least two identifiers.

rules.title: No high-pressure tactics
rules.text: Agents must not use artificial urgency to pressure a customer into an immediate decision on a financial product.

rules.title: Cooling-off period
rules.text: For credit products and insurance add-ons, the agent must inform the customer of their right to cancel within the statutory cooling-off period.

rules.title: No discriminatory language
rules.text: Agents must not make statements that reference or imply differential treatment based on a customer's age, race, gender, religion, national origin, or disability.

rules.title: Accurate risk representation
rules.text: Agents must not understate the risk level of an investment product or describe a variable-return product as safe or risk-free.

rules.title: No unauthorized product substitution
rules.text: Agents must not enroll or upgrade a customer into a different product than the one requested without explicit, recorded consent.

rules.title: Call recording disclosure
rules.text: Agents must inform the customer that the call may be recorded for quality and compliance purposes, at or near the start of the call.

rules.title: Complaint handling
rules.text: If a customer expresses dissatisfaction or asks to file a complaint, the agent must acknowledge it and provide the complaint escalation path.

rules.title: No unauthorized collections threats
rules.text: Agents must not threaten legal action, wage garnishment, or credit consequences that are not accurate or authorized by policy.

rules.title: Vulnerable customer protocol
rules.text: If a customer discloses a circumstance suggesting vulnerability (cognitive difficulty, recent bereavement, financial hardship), the agent must slow down, offer to involve a trusted third party, and avoid upselling.
